functions.match_me_not:
scoreboard players set minigame variables 422
scoreboard players set music variables 17
forceload add -298 -385 -360 -319
execute as @a[scores={minigameplayer=1..4}] unless score @s minigameplayer matches 2..3 run tp @s -325.0 -9 -376.0
execute as @a unless score @s minigameplayer matches 2..3 run tp @s 26 1 533
effect give @a minecraft:levitation 4 0 true
effect give @a minecraft:weakness infinite 99 true
title @a title {fallback:"Match Me Not",translate:"mcp.match_me_not",bold:1b,color:"dark_green",type:"translatable"}
playsound minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup master @a ~ ~ ~ 10 2 1
execute if score players variables matches ..4 run tellraw @a {fallback:"Choose one of four materials to build your platform (by dropping the item).",translate:"mcp.match_me_not.1",color:"dark_green",type:"translatable"}
execute if score players variables matches 5..6 run tellraw @a {fallback:"Choose one of five materials to build your platform (by dropping the item).",translate:"mcp.match_me_not.2",color:"dark_green",type:"translatable"}
execute if score players variables matches 7..8 run tellraw @a {fallback:"Choose one of six materials to build your platform (by dropping the item).",translate:"mcp.match_me_not.3",color:"dark_green",type:"translatable"}
execute if score players variables matches 9..10 run tellraw @a {fallback:"Choose one of seven materials to build your platform (by dropping the item).",translate:"mcp.match_me_not.4",color:"dark_green",type:"translatable"}
scoreboard players set currentRule variables 0
scoreboard players set playingMMN variables 0
scoreboard players set @a[scores={Player=1..}] Points 0
scoreboard objectives add item_chosen dummy
scoreboard players operation mmn_doubles_mode variables = doubles_mode variables
execute if score gamemode variables matches 0 run scoreboard players set mmn_doubles_mode variables 0
schedule function mcp:match_me_not_rules 3s

#notes for build world: shift over MCP2 brew by 1 bock. set sign
